other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Haryana and have resided in the state for at least one year at the time of application
Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Male applicants must have a height of 3 feet 8 inches or less; female applicants must have a height of 3 feet 3 inches or less (approximately 70% handicap)
Applicant must submit a certificate from the Civil Surgeon confirming dwarfism
benefits_summary: Monthly allowance of Rs. 2500 per beneficiary.
documents_required: Certificate from the Civil Surgeon confirming dwarfism
